items.title: Mental health in elite athletes: International Olympic Committee consensus statement (2026)
items.summary: The updated International Olympic Committee consensus statement (2026) emphasizes that mental health symptoms and disorders are common in elite athletes, may be sport-related, and impact performance, recommending routine screening and monitoring.
items.curatedReason: 这份 IOC 共识声明强调精英运动员心理健康问题普遍且可能与运动相关，并推荐使用验证工具进行常规筛查和监测。它确认了心理健康在运动康复中的重要性，你在日常实践中应更关注运动员的心理状态并考虑恰当的转诊。
items.titleZh: 精英运动员心理健康：国际奥委会共识声明（2026）
items.summaryZh: 更新后的国际奥委会共识声明（2026）强调，精英运动员的心理健康症状和障碍普遍存在，可能与运动相关并影响表现，建议进行常规筛查和监测。
items.curatedReasonEn: This IOC consensus statement highlights the prevalence of mental health issues in elite athletes, their potential sport-related etiologies, and recommends routine screening and monitoring. It affirms the importance of mental health in sports rehabilitation, prompting you to pay closer attention to athletes' psychological states and consider appropriate referrals.

items.title: Moving Forward Together. Part 6: Transforming Musculoskeletal Health Physical Therapy for Indigenous Peoples-A Call to Action.
items.summary: The 'Moving Forward Together' series calls on musculoskeletal physical therapists, organizations, and systems to engage in a multisector effort to improve musculoskeletal care and outcomes for Indigenous Peoples in clinical practice, research, and education.
items.curatedReason: 本系列文章直接呼吁你所在的肌肉骨骼物理治疗机构和系统，必须正视并改善原住民的肌肉骨骼健康不平等问题。作为临床医生，你的角色不仅仅是治疗，更是要在实践、研究和教育中积极成为原住民社区的盟友和倡导者。
items.titleZh: 携手前行。第六部分：为原住民的肌肉骨骼健康物理治疗转型——行动号召。
items.summaryZh: “携手前行”系列呼吁肌肉骨骼物理治疗师、组织和系统在临床实践、研究和教育中共同努力，改善原住民的肌肉骨骼护理和结局。
items.curatedReasonEn: This series is a direct call for your musculoskeletal PT practice and system to confront and improve health inequities for Indigenous Peoples. Beyond direct treatment, you are urged to actively become an ally and advocate within Indigenous communities across your clinical practice, research, and educational roles.
items.journal: The Journal of orthopaedic and sports physical therapy

items.title: Additive Effects of Repetitive Transcranial Magnetic Stimulation and Transcranial Direct Current Stimulation on Robotic Therapy for Upper Extremity Recovery After Chronic Ischemic Stroke: A Randomized, Double-Blind, Sham-Controlled Trial.
items.summary: A randomized, double-blind, sham-controlled trial (N=36) found that adding repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation (rTMS) or transcranial direct current stimulation (tDCS) to robotic therapy did not provide additional benefits for upper extremity motor and functional recovery in patients with chronic ischemic stroke.
items.curatedReason: 对于慢性缺血性卒中上肢功能障碍患者，这项 N=36 的 RCT 明确指出，在机器人治疗基础上增加 rTMS 或 tDCS 并不能带来额外的运动和功能恢复益处。这提示我们，不应盲目叠加这些治疗方式，审慎评估其必要性。
items.titleZh: 重复经颅磁刺激和经颅直流电刺激联合机器人疗法对慢性缺血性卒中上肢恢复的累加效应：一项随机、双盲、假对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机、双盲、假对照试验（N=36）发现，对慢性缺血性卒中上肢功能障碍患者，在机器人疗法基础上额外增加重复经颅磁刺激（rTMS）或经颅直流电刺激（tDCS）并未带来额外的运动和功能恢复益处。
items.curatedReasonEn: This N=36 RCT strongly indicates that adding rTMS or tDCS to robotic therapy offers no additional benefits for upper extremity motor and functional recovery in patients with chronic ischemic stroke. You should reconsider the clinical utility of combining these modalities and avoid unnecessary treatment layering.
items.limitation: 研究样本量相对较小（N=36），可能影响结果的普遍性。
items.limitationEn: The study's relatively small sample size (N=36) may limit the generalizability of the findings.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

items.title: Exercise prescription: Physiotherapy's most important and least standardized skill.
items.summary: This commentary highlights the pervasive inconsistency and lack of standardization in exercise prescription within musculoskeletal physiotherapy, emphasizing the need for a shared language and systematic process.
items.curatedReason: 在你的临床实践中，运动处方的标准化不足很常见。这篇文章点出了痛点，强调 PT 行业需要建立更统一的语言和流程来指导运动处方的制定和沟通，这应该推动你反思自己的处方习惯。
items.titleZh: 运动处方：物理治疗中最重要但标准化程度最低的技能
items.summaryZh: 这篇评论指出，肌肉骨骼物理治疗中运动处方普遍存在不一致和标准化不足的问题，强调需要建立统一的语言和系统流程。
items.curatedReasonEn: In your clinical practice, the lack of standardization in exercise prescription is common. This article highlights critical pain points, emphasizing the need for a more unified language and process in the PT profession to guide the development and communication of exercise prescriptions. This should prompt you to reflect on your own prescribing habits.

items.title: From Injury to Inclusion: Evidence From the International Spinal Cord Injury Survey (InSCI).
items.summary: An evidence map of the International Spinal Cord Injury Community Survey (InSCI) identified 117 peer-reviewed publications by April 2026, with healthcare needs and epidemiology being the largest categories, indicating significant research contributions and remaining knowledge gaps.
items.curatedReason: InSCI 问卷的证据图谱让你对全球脊髓损伤（SCI）研究的广度、焦点和知识缺口有清晰认识。可利用它快速定位你感兴趣的 SCI 亚专业方向，避免重复工作。
items.titleZh: 从损伤到融合：国际脊髓损伤调查（InSCI）的证据
items.summaryZh: 国际脊髓损伤社区调查（InSCI）的证据图谱显示，截至 2026 年 4 月，已产生 117 篇同行评议论文，其中医疗需求和流行病学是最大的类别，表明其显著的研究贡献和尚存的知识缺口。
items.curatedReasonEn: This InSCI evidence map, covering 117 peer-reviewed publications by April 2026, highlights that research is heavily concentrated on healthcare needs and epidemiology. If you're involved in spinal cord injury (SCI) research, use this map to quickly grasp current foci and identify under-researched areas, streamlining your efforts.
items.limitation: 证据图谱本身是对现有文献的汇总分析，不提供新的临床干预效果证据。
items.limitationEn: The evidence map itself is a summary analysis of existing literature and does not provide new evidence on the effects of clinical interventions.
items.journal: American journal of physical medicine & rehabilitation

items.title: Integrated rehabilitation incorporating aquatic therapy following posterior cruciate ligament reconstruction: a case report.
items.summary: A case report of a 51-year-old woman showed that integrated rehabilitation incorporating aquatic therapy following PCL reconstruction helped facilitate early functional recovery and reduced joint loading.
items.curatedReason: PCL 重建术后水疗的证据仍然稀缺。本病例报告提示水疗在早期功能恢复中可能发挥作用，但别把它当成常规方案。
items.titleZh: 整合水疗的后交叉韧带重建术后康复：一例病例报告
items.summaryZh: 一例 51 岁女性的病例报告显示，后交叉韧带（PCL）重建术后整合水疗的康复方案有助于促进早期功能恢复并减轻关节负荷。
items.curatedReasonEn: Evidence for aquatic therapy after PCL reconstruction remains scarce. This case report suggests aquatic therapy may facilitate early functional recovery, but don't integrate it into routine protocols yet.
items.limitation: 本研究为单病例报告，证据等级低，结果外推性差。
items.limitationEn: This is a single case report with a low level of evidence and limited generalizability.

items.title: Repetitive Transcranial Magnetic Stimulation for Dizziness, Balance, and Postural Stability in Adult Patients With Chronic Peripheral Vestibular Dizziness.
items.summary: A double-blind RCT with 56 adults with chronic vestibular dizziness found that repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation (rTMS) combined with vestibular rehabilitation (VR) significantly improved dizziness, balance, and postural stability over 8 weeks compared to sham stimulation + VR.
items.curatedReason: 这项高质量 RCT 表明，经颅磁刺激（rTMS）联合前庭康复能显著改善慢性前庭性眩晕患者的眩晕症状、平衡和姿势稳定性，为这类难治性患者提供了新的干预策略。
items.titleZh: 重复经颅磁刺激对慢性周围性前庭性眩晕成年患者眩晕、平衡和姿势稳定性的影响。
items.summaryZh: 一项对56名慢性前庭性眩晕成年患者的双盲随机对照试验显示，重复经颅磁刺激（rTMS）联合前庭康复（VR）治疗8周后，患者的眩晕、平衡和姿势稳定性均得到显著改善，优于安慰剂刺激联合VR组。
items.curatedReasonEn: This high-quality RCT indicates that repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation (rTMS) combined with vestibular rehabilitation significantly improves dizziness, balance, and postural stability in patients with chronic peripheral vestibular dizziness, offering a new intervention strategy for these challenging cases.
items.limitation: 研究评估了为期 8 周的治疗效果，但需要更长期的随访来确定维持效果。
items.limitationEn: The study evaluated effects over an 8-week treatment period, but longer-term follow-up is needed to determine sustained benefits.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

items.title: Acute Effects of Varying Neuromuscular Electrical Stimulation Amplitude on Quadriceps Isometric Torque and Muscle Thickness in Healthy Young Adults: A Randomized Split-Limb Trial.
items.summary: A randomized split-limb trial in healthy young adults found that increasing neuromuscular electrical stimulation (NMES) amplitude acutely enhanced quadriceps isometric torque and muscle thickness, suggesting a dose-response relationship for acute neuromuscular responses.
items.curatedReason: 本研究提示，增加神经肌肉电刺激的耐受幅度可以急性增强股四头肌的等长扭矩和肌肉厚度，但仍需进一步研究以明确临床最佳剂量。
items.titleZh: 不同神经肌肉电刺激幅度对健康年轻人股四头肌等长扭矩和肌肉厚度的急性影响：一项随机分肢试验。
items.summaryZh: 一项对健康年轻人的随机分肢试验显示，增加神经肌肉电刺激（NMES）的耐受幅度能够急性增强股四头肌的等长扭矩和肌肉厚度，提示神经肌肉急性反应存在剂量效应关系。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study suggests that increasing tolerated neuromuscular electrical stimulation amplitude acutely enhances quadriceps isometric torque and muscle thickness, though further research is needed to determine optimal clinical dosing.
items.limitation: 研究对象为健康年轻人，结果外推到临床患者群体时需谨慎。
items.limitationEn: The study was conducted on healthy young adults, and results should be applied cautiously to clinical patient populations.
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: Effects of a Virtual Reality-Based Balance Training Program on Clinical Outcomes and Cortical Oscillatory Activity: A Combined Behavioral and EEG Study.
items.summary: A prospective single-group repeated-measures study (n=28) found that 12 VR balance training sessions over 4 weeks improved clinical mobility outcomes and altered cortical oscillatory activity in subacute stroke survivors.
items.curatedReason: 虚拟现实平衡训练对亚急性卒中患者的平衡和皮层活动有积极影响。这提示 VR 技术可作为传统康复的有效补充，但还需要更强力的随机对照证据来明确其临床定位。
items.titleZh: 虚拟现实平衡训练对临床结果和皮层振荡活动的影响：一项行为与脑电图结合研究
items.summaryZh: 一项前瞻性单组重复测量研究（n=28）显示，亚急性卒中幸存者完成 4 周共 12 次虚拟现实平衡训练后，临床移动性结局得到改善，皮层振荡活动也发生变化。
items.curatedReasonEn: VR-based balance training showed positive effects on balance and cortical activity in subacute stroke survivors. This suggests VR technology can supplement traditional rehab, but stronger RCT evidence is needed to clarify its clinical role.
items.limitation: 这是一项单组重复测量研究，缺乏对照组，无法排除安慰剂效应或自然恢复的影响。
items.limitationEn: This was a single-group repeated-measures study lacking a control group, preventing the exclusion of placebo effects or natural recovery.

items.title: Effects of sportsmetrics training on biomechanical and functional performance outcomes related to ACL injury risk: a systematic review and meta-analysis
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis confirmed the positive effects of SportsMetrics training on ACL injury-related biomechanical deficits and functional performance outcomes in athletes.
items.curatedReason: 如果你在设计 ACL 损伤预防或康复项目，可以有信心地将 SportsMetrics 训练纳入考量。这项高质量的系统综述和荟萃分析确证了它能有效改善与 ACL 损伤风险相关的生物力学和功能性表现。
items.titleZh: SportsMetrics 训练对 ACL 损伤风险相关生物力学和功能表现结局的影响：一项系统综述和荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项系统综述和荟萃分析证实了 SportsMetrics 训练对运动员 ACL 损伤相关生物力学缺陷和功能表现结局的积极影响。
items.curatedReasonEn: You can confidently incorporate SportsMetrics training into your ACL injury prevention or rehabilitation programs. This high-quality systematic review and meta-analysis confirms its effectiveness in improving ACL injury-related biomechanical deficits and functional performance outcomes.
items.limitation: 虽然是系统综述，但原始研究间的异质性或研究质量差异可能影响了综合结果的强度。
items.limitationEn: Although a systematic review, heterogeneity or quality differences among original studies may affect the strength of the pooled results.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Short-term inspiratory muscle training, aerobic exercise, and detraining in women with COPD: a randomized controlled trial
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial in women with COPD found that short-term inspiratory muscle training (IMT), aerobic exercise (AE), and combined IMT+AE all significantly improved inspiratory muscle strength, exercise capacity, and quality of life, with effects diminishing after a detraining period.
items.curatedReason: 这项随机对照试验表明，短期吸气肌训练（IMT）和有氧运动（AE）都能改善女性 COPD 患者的心肺功能和生活质量，且停训后效果会减弱。这支持你为 COPD 患者提供有氧运动和 IMT，并强调了持续训练的重要性。
items.titleZh: COPD 女性短期吸气肌训练、有氧运动和停训效应：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 COPD 女性的随机对照试验发现，短期吸气肌训练（IMT）、有氧运动（AE）以及联合训练均能显著改善吸气肌力量、运动能力和生活质量，但停训后效果有所减弱。
items.curatedReasonEn: This randomized controlled trial indicates that short-term inspiratory muscle training (IMT) and aerobic exercise (AE) both improve cardiopulmonary function and quality of life in women with COPD, with effects diminishing after detraining. This supports providing aerobic exercise and IMT for COPD patients and highlights the importance of continuous training.
items.limitation: 研究对象仅为女性COPD患者，结果外推到男性或其他COPD亚型时需谨慎。
items.limitationEn: The study included only female COPD patients, so caution is needed when generalizing results to men or other COPD subtypes.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Manifestations of Oral Muscle Mass, Tongue Strength, and Endurance in Patients with Stroke Across Varying Degrees of Swallowing Function: A Pilot Study.
items.summary: A pilot cross-sectional study of 41 stroke patients found varying oral muscle mass, elasticity, and tongue performance across different swallowing function levels (FOIS 1-3, 4-6, 7), assessed using ultrasonography and sonoelastography.
items.curatedReason: 这项纳入 41 名卒中患者的探索性研究提示，不同吞咽功能水平（FOIS 1-3, 4-6, 7）与口腔肌肉质量、弹性及舌功能表现存在关联。评估吞咽障碍时，应考虑将超声及超声弹性成像作为补充工具，以更精细地识别潜在的病理生理机制。
items.titleZh: 卒中患者不同吞咽功能水平下口腔肌肉质量、舌力量和耐力的表现：一项初步研究
items.summaryZh: 一项对 41 名卒中患者进行的初步横断面研究发现，根据功能性口腔摄入量表（FOIS）分级，口腔肌肉质量、弹性以及舌功能表现（通过超声和声波弹性成像评估）在不同吞咽功能水平的患者之间存在差异。
items.curatedReasonEn: This pilot study with 41 stroke patients suggests a link between varying swallowing function levels (FOIS 1-3, 4-6, 7) and oral muscle mass, elasticity, and tongue performance. When assessing dysphagia, consider ultrasonography and sonoelastography as supplementary tools for a more refined identification of underlying pathophysiological mechanisms.
items.limitation: 这是一项横断面小样本研究（n=41），难以建立因果关系，结果的外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: This is a small cross-sectional pilot study (n=41), which limits the ability to establish causality and generalizability of the findings.

items.title: Altered inter-joint coordination strategies of the lower extremity and pelvis in elite rowers with chronic low back pain
items.summary: Elite rowers with chronic low back pain exhibit altered inter-joint coordination strategies of the lower extremity and pelvis, as identified in this study.
items.curatedReason: 有慢性腰痛的精英赛艇运动员可能存在下肢和骨盆的关节间协调策略改变。评估这类患者时，除了传统检查，应关注其运动模式和协调性，这可能对你的生物力学分析和干预方案设计有提示作用。
items.titleZh: 慢性腰痛精英赛艇运动员下肢和骨盆关节间协调策略的改变
items.summaryZh: 这项研究发现，患有慢性腰痛的精英赛艇运动员在下肢和骨盆的关节间协调策略上存在改变。
items.curatedReasonEn: Elite rowers with chronic low back pain may exhibit altered inter-joint coordination strategies of the lower extremity and pelvis. When assessing these patients, beyond traditional examinations, pay attention to their movement patterns and coordination, as this may inform your biomechanical analysis and intervention design.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Exercise training during hospitalization in community-acquired pneumonia: effects on functional ability, body composition, and physical activity level
items.summary: Exercise programs applied during acute hospitalization for community-acquired pneumonia may improve functional ability, body composition, and physical activity levels.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究提示，对于社区获得性肺炎住院患者，住院期间的运动训练可能改善其功能能力、身体成分和体力活动水平。这能支持你在急性期积极介入，降低患者因卧床导致的衰退风险。
items.titleZh: 社区获得性肺炎住院期间运动训练：对功能能力、身体成分和体力活动水平的影响
items.summaryZh: 研究显示，在社区获得性肺炎患者急性住院期间实施的运动计划，可能改善其功能能力、身体成分和体力活动水平。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study suggests that exercise training during hospitalization for community-acquired pneumonia may improve functional ability, body composition, and physical activity levels. This supports active intervention during the acute phase to reduce the risk of decline due to bed rest.
items.limitation: 摘要未提供研究设计细节或样本量，限制了对其证据强度的全面评估。
items.limitationEn: The abstract does not provide details on study design or sample size, limiting a full assessment of its evidence strength.

items.title: Understanding Anterior Cruciate Ligament Adaptation: Structural, Mechanical, and Healing Considerations
items.summary: This narrative review synthesizes animal and human evidence on ACL mechanobiology, emphasizing its adaptive nature to mechanical stimuli and its role beyond a passive stabilizer.
items.curatedReason: ACL 不仅仅是被动稳定结构，它能动态响应机械刺激，具备适应性和愈合能力。这份综述提醒我们，在 ACL 损伤的评估和康复中，应充分考虑其生物力学特性和愈合潜力，而不是仅将其视为一个简单的机械结构。
items.titleZh: 理解前交叉韧带适应：结构、力学和愈合考量
items.summaryZh: 这篇叙述性综述综合了动物和人类关于 ACL 机械生物学的证据，强调其对机械刺激的适应性以及作为被动稳定器之外的作用。
items.curatedReasonEn: The ACL is not merely a passive stabilizer; it dynamically responds to mechanical stimuli, demonstrating adaptive and healing capabilities. This review reminds us to fully consider its biomechanical properties and healing potential in ACL injury assessment and rehabilitation, rather than viewing it as a simple mechanical structure.
items.limitation: 作为一篇叙述性综述，其证据等级低于系统综述或RCT，可能存在作者选择偏倚。
items.limitationEn: As a narrative review, its evidence level is lower than that of systematic reviews or RCTs, and author selection bias may be present.

items.title: Influence of knee hyperextension persisting into preswing on swing-phase kinematics through forward propulsion in poststroke hemiparetic gait.
items.summary: A study with 30 chronic poststroke hemiparetic patients found that knee hyperextension persisting into preswing was associated with reduced peak forward propulsive force and altered swing-phase kinematics, including functional limb shortening and peak knee-flexion angle.
items.curatedReason: 本研究揭示卒中偏瘫步态中摆前膝关节过伸与推进力减弱、摆动期运动学改变相关。这提示临床在评估和干预卒中患者步态时，需关注摆前膝过伸模式，可能与后续推进效率和肢体功能长度改变有关。
items.titleZh: 卒中偏瘫步态中摆前膝关节过伸对摆动期运动学和前向推进力的影响
items.summaryZh: 一项对 30 名慢性卒中偏瘫患者的研究发现，膝关节过伸持续至摆前阶段与峰值前向推进力减弱以及摆动期运动学改变（包括功能性肢体缩短和膝关节屈曲峰值角度）相关联。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study indicates that preswing knee hyperextension in poststroke hemiparetic gait is associated with reduced forward propulsion and altered swing-phase kinematics. Clinicians should consider preswing knee hyperextension when assessing and intervening in stroke gait, as it may impact propulsion efficiency and functional limb shortening.
items.limitation: 本研究为小样本观察性研究，结论的因果关系和普适性有限。
items.limitationEn: This is a small-sample observational study, limiting the generalizability and causal inference of its findings.

items.title: Cardiovascular and autonomic responses to transcutaneous spinal cord stimulation combined with activity-based therapy after chronic spinal cord injury: An exploratory study from the MACHINE trial
items.summary: An exploratory case series from a randomized trial involving 8 adults with chronic motor-complete spinal cord injury found that 12 weeks of body weight-supported treadmill training combined with transcutaneous spinal cord stimulation led to changes in cardiovascular and autonomic responses, including improvements in blood pressure regulation.
items.curatedReason: 对于慢性脊髓损伤患者，经皮脊髓电刺激结合活动性疗法（如 BWSTT）可能影响心血管和自主神经反应。在临床实践中，您应关注这种组合干预在改善自主神经功能障碍方面的潜力，但需注意其仍处于探索阶段，数据来自小样本。
items.titleZh: 慢性脊髓损伤后经皮脊髓电刺激结合活动性疗法的心血管与自主神经反应：MACHINE 试验的探索性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项对 8 名慢性运动完全性脊髓损伤成人进行的探索性案例研究（来自 MACHINE 随机试验）发现，为期 12 周的体重支持跑台训练结合经皮脊髓电刺激，能改变心血管和自主神经反应，包括改善血压调节。
items.curatedReasonEn: For individuals with chronic spinal cord injury, transcutaneous spinal cord stimulation combined with activity-based therapy (like BWSTT) may influence cardiovascular and autonomic responses. In practice, you should be aware of this combination's potential to improve autonomic dysfunction, but note that it is still in an exploratory phase with small sample data.
items.limitation: 本研究是来自更大试验的探索性案例系列，样本量小（n=8），且未报告主要结局的效应量。
items.limitationEn: This study is an exploratory case series from a larger trial with a small sample size (n=8) and did not report effect sizes for primary outcomes.

items.title: When algorithms don't care: physiotherapy and the post-professional turn.
items.summary: This paper analyzes how physiotherapy, traditionally resistant to restructuring forces, is entering a post-professional era marked by practitioner marginalization due to commodification, challenges to expertise, and digital disruption.
items.curatedReason: PT 行业正在进入一个“后专业化”时代，这可能导致专业人员被边缘化。你需要警惕商品化、专业知识受到挑战以及数字化颠覆带来的潜在冲击，并开始思考如何适应这些变化。
items.titleZh: 当算法不关心：物理治疗与后专业化转向
items.summaryZh: 本文分析了传统上抵制重组力量的物理治疗如何进入一个“后专业化”时代，其特点是由于商品化、专业知识面临挑战以及数字颠覆，从业者在护理协调和提供中的边缘化。
items.curatedReasonEn: The PT profession is entering a “post-professional” era, potentially leading to practitioner marginalization. You need to be aware of the impending impacts of commodification, challenges to expertise, and digital disruption, and begin strategizing how to adapt.

items.title: Growing Our Impact and Advancing Pediatric Physical Therapy.
items.summary: This article discusses strategies for expanding the impact and advancing the field of pediatric physical therapy.
items.curatedReason: 这是一篇社论，着眼于儿科物理治疗的未来发展和影响力。虽然是行业内部观点，但提醒我们关注儿科专业领域的整体战略方向。
items.titleZh: 壮大影响力，推进儿科物理治疗。
items.summaryZh: 本文探讨了扩大儿科物理治疗影响力并推进该领域发展的策略。
items.curatedReasonEn: This editorial focuses on the future development and impact of pediatric physical therapy. While it offers an internal perspective, it serves as a reminder to consider the overall strategic direction within the pediatric specialty.
items.journal: Pediatric physical therapy : the official publication of the Section on Pediatrics of the American Physical Therapy Association

items.title: Quality indicators for Spanish hospital-based physical therapy units: a feasibility and inter-rater reliability study.
items.summary: A Spanish multicenter observational study assessed the feasibility and inter-rater reliability of 22 quality indicators for hospital-based physical therapy units, identifying 13 indicators that were both feasible and showed high concordance across evaluators.
items.curatedReason: 这份西班牙多中心研究，在评估医院物理治疗科室质量指标的工具化方面有不错的信噪比。它确认了 13 个具有可行性和跨评估者一致性的指标，为日后制定 PT 科室质量管理标准提供了实证基础。
items.titleZh: 西班牙医院物理治疗科室质量指标：可行性与评估者间信度研究
items.summaryZh: 一项西班牙多中心观察研究评估了医院物理治疗科室 22 项质量指标的可行性与评估者间信度，其中 13 项指标被证实可行且评估者间一致性高。
items.curatedReasonEn: This multicenter study from Spain offers good signal-to-noise ratio in instrumenting quality indicators for hospital-based physical therapy units. It validates 13 indicators with demonstrated feasibility and inter-rater reliability, providing an empirical basis for future PT department quality management standards.
items.limitation: 研究仅在西班牙三家医院进行，其结果在其他医疗系统中的普适性有待验证。
items.limitationEn: The study was conducted in only three hospitals in Spain, and the generalizability of its findings to other healthcare systems requires further validation.

items.title: Bidirectional association between injuries and mental health symptoms among elite athletes: a systematic review
items.summary: A systematic review of 25 studies found a bidirectional association between musculoskeletal injuries and mental health symptoms among elite athletes, indicating that mental health symptoms can precede injury, and injury can lead to subsequent mental health symptoms.
items.curatedReason: 这项系统综述明确了精英运动员伤病与心理健康症状之间的双向关联。你需要认识到，心理健康问题可能导致受伤，而受伤反过来也会影响心理健康，因此在康复和预防中，务必同时评估和管理这两个方面。
items.titleZh: 精英运动员伤病与心理健康症状之间的双向关联：一项系统综述
items.summaryZh: 一项包含 25 项研究的系统综述发现，精英运动员的肌肉骨骼损伤与心理健康症状之间存在双向关联，表明心理健康症状可能先于受伤，而受伤也可能导致随后的心理健康症状。
items.curatedReasonEn: This systematic review clarifies the bidirectional association between injuries and mental health symptoms in elite athletes. You need to recognize that mental health issues can lead to injuries, and injuries, in turn, can affect mental health, making it crucial to assess and manage both aspects concurrently in rehabilitation and prevention.
items.limitation: 纳入研究的方法学异质性较高，且多数研究为观察性，无法完全确立因果关系。
items.limitationEn: The included studies had high methodological heterogeneity, and most were observational, thus not fully establishing causality.

items.title: Biopsychosocial predictors of functional recovery in chronic low back pain following physiotherapy: A survival analysis study.
items.summary: A prospective observational cohort study of 250 adults with chronic non-specific low back pain found that baseline biopsychosocial factors, particularly Oswestry Disability Index (ODI) and pain catastrophizing, predicted functional recovery time following individualized physiotherapy.
items.curatedReason: 这项前瞻性队列研究提示，慢性腰痛患者接受物理治疗后，功能恢复时间受到基线生物心理社会因素的显著影响，其中ODI和疼痛灾难化是主要预测因子。
items.titleZh: 物理治疗后慢性腰痛功能恢复的生物心理社会预测因子：一项生存分析研究
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 250 名慢性非特异性腰痛成人进行的前瞻性观察队列研究发现，基线生物心理社会因素，特别是 Oswestry 残障指数 (ODI) 和疼痛灾难化，能够预测个体化物理治疗后的功能恢复时间。
items.curatedReasonEn: This prospective cohort study suggests that functional recovery time in chronic low back pain patients undergoing physiotherapy is significantly influenced by baseline biopsychosocial factors, with ODI and pain catastrophizing identified as key predictors.
items.limitation: 本研究为单中心观察性研究，缺乏对照组且随访时间相对较短，可能存在混杂因素影响结果。
items.limitationEn: This was a single-center observational study without a control group and a relatively short follow-up, potentially leading to confounding factors influencing the results.

items.title: Applying the International Classification of Functioning, Disability and Health to Classify Upper Limb Outcome Measures in Stroke Rehabilitation: A Construct-Driven Perspective.
items.summary: This perspective emphasizes using the International Classification of Functioning, Disability and Health (ICF) to classify upper limb outcome measures in stroke rehabilitation, advocating for a construct-driven approach to clarify whether measures assess neuromuscular impairments or activity limitations.
items.curatedReason: 这项分析强调，在卒中康复中，上肢功能评估应更清晰地结合 ICF 框架，区分评估的是损伤还是活动受限，避免测量工具解读混淆。
items.titleZh: 运用国际功能、残疾和健康分类法对卒中康复上肢结局测量进行分类：一项以结构为导向的视角
items.summaryZh: 本视角强调在卒中康复中运用国际功能、残疾和健康分类法（ICF）对上肢结局测量进行分类，倡导以结构为导向的方法，以明确测量工具评估的是神经肌肉损伤还是活动受限。
items.curatedReasonEn: This analysis emphasizes that upper limb functional assessment in stroke rehabilitation should more clearly integrate the ICF framework to distinguish between impairment and activity limitation, preventing measurement tool misinterpretation.

items.title: The effect of online physical activity monitoring on physical activity level, psychological health, fatigue, and quality of life in patients with multiple sclerosis: a randomized controlled trial.
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial with 42 individuals with multiple sclerosis (MS) found that continuous online monitoring of walking-based physical activity via a messaging application significantly improved physical activity levels, psychological health, and quality of life.
items.curatedReason: 这项 RCT 提示，通过消息应用程序进行在线身体活动监测，能有效提升多发性硬化症（MS）患者的身体活动水平、心理健康和生活质量，你可以考虑将这类数字工具整合到 MS 患者的康复管理中。
items.titleZh: 在线身体活动监测对多发性硬化症患者身体活动水平、心理健康、疲劳和生活质量的影响：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 42 名多发性硬化症（MS）患者的随机对照试验发现，通过消息应用程序持续监测步行活动显著改善了患者的身体活动水平、心理健康和生活质量。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT suggests that online physical activity monitoring via messaging apps can effectively improve physical activity levels, psychological health, and quality of life in MS patients. You may consider integrating such digital tools into MS rehabilitation management.
items.limitation: 本研究样本量较小（42 人），且干预时间相对较短，长期效果和推广性仍需进一步验证。
items.limitationEn: This study had a small sample size (42 participants) and a relatively short intervention period, so long-term effects and generalizability require further validation.

items.title: Depressive symptoms in high-performance athletes and non-athletes: a comparative meta-analysis update
items.summary: An updated comparative meta-analysis of 10 studies found no significant difference in the prevalence of mild or more severe depressive symptoms between high-performance athletes and non-athletes.
items.curatedReason: 这项更新的荟萃分析发现，与非运动员相比，高水平运动员出现轻度或更严重抑郁症状的风险并无显著差异。这挑战了“运动员心理更健康”的普遍观念，提示你在实践中应平等关注运动员的心理健康。
items.titleZh: 高水平运动员与非运动员抑郁症状的比较荟萃分析更新
items.summaryZh: 一项涵盖 10 项研究的比较荟萃分析更新发现，高水平运动员与非运动员之间，轻度或更严重抑郁症状的患病率没有显著差异。
items.curatedReasonEn: This updated meta-analysis finds no significant difference in the risk of mild or severe depressive symptoms between high-performance athletes and non-athletes. This challenges the common perception of athletes being mentally healthier, prompting you to equally prioritize athletes' mental health in practice.
items.limitation: 纳入研究的数量有限（10 项），且存在方法学异质性，可能影响结果的普遍性。
items.limitationEn: The limited number of included studies (10) and methodological heterogeneity may affect the generalizability of the results.

items.title: Test-Retest Reliability of Hierarchical Proprioception Assessment of the Wrist
items.summary: This study evaluated the within-day test-retest reliability of three robotic wrist tasks (joint detection threshold, same-frame joint-to-joint matching, and cross-frame joint-to-visual matching) in 20 neurotypical adults, comparing performance across different levels of proprioceptive judgment.
items.curatedReason: 腕关节本体感觉评估的机器人重测信度初步可用，但在 20 名健康成人中得出的数据，不足以指导我们在临床上立即采纳这些分级评估工具。还需要更多病人数据验证。
items.titleZh: 腕关节分层本体感觉评估的重测信度
items.summaryZh: 本研究评估了 20 名神经正常成人在三项机器人腕关节任务（关节检测阈值、同框架关节对关节匹配、跨框架关节对视觉匹配）中的日内重测信度，并比较了不同本体感觉判断水平下的表现。
items.curatedReasonEn: While the preliminary robotic test-retest reliability for wrist proprioception assessment is promising, data from only 20 neurotypical adults are insufficient to immediately adopt these hierarchical assessment tools in clinical practice. Further validation with patient populations is needed.
items.limitation: 本研究样本量较小（20 名神经正常成人），且仅评估了日内重测信度，未能涵盖更广泛的人群或长期稳定性。
items.limitationEn: This study had a small sample size (20 neurotypical adults) and only assessed within-day test-retest reliability, not covering broader populations or long-term stability.

items.title: Simplifying ICF Assessment for Individuals with Spinal Cord Injury with Lower Limb Dysfunction Using Item Response Theory and Graphical Models.
items.summary: A cross-sectional, multicenter study with 252 participants developed and validated a parameterized assessment tool for individuals with spinal cord injury (SCI) with lower limb dysfunction, based on the ICF framework, using item response theory and graphical modeling.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究利用先进的统计方法简化了脊髓损伤患者下肢功能障碍的 ICF 评估，为临床实践提供了一个更参数化、高效的工具。
items.titleZh: 运用项目反应理论和图形模型简化脊髓损伤下肢功能障碍患者的 ICF 评估
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 252 名脊髓损伤（SCI）下肢功能障碍患者的横断面多中心研究，运用项目反应理论和图形模型，开发并验证了一个基于 ICF 框架的参数化评估工具。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study simplifies ICF assessment for lower limb dysfunction in SCI patients using advanced statistical methods, providing a more parameterized and efficient tool for clinical practice.
items.limitation: 本研究为横断面多中心研究，无法评估评估工具随时间的敏感性或预测价值。
items.limitationEn: This cross-sectional, multicenter study cannot assess the longitudinal sensitivity or predictive value of the assessment tool.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

items.title: International Olympic Committee Sport Mental Health Assessment Tool 2 (IOC SMHAT2): development, content validity and feasibility
items.summary: The International Olympic Committee (IOC) developed and validated the IOC Sport Mental Health Assessment Tool 2 (IOC SMHAT2) for sports medicine physicians, building on user feedback and misclassification analysis of the previous version.
items.curatedReason: 国际奥委会开发并验证了新的运动心理健康评估工具（IOC SMHAT2），为体育医学医师和其他运动医学专业人员提供了更全面、实用的心理健康筛查手段。
items.titleZh: 国际奥委会运动心理健康评估工具 2 (IOC SMHAT2)：开发、内容效度和可行性
items.summaryZh: 国际奥委会（IOC）基于用户反馈和对前一版本误分类分析，开发并验证了运动心理健康评估工具 2 (IOC SMHAT2)，供体育医学医师使用。
items.curatedReasonEn: The IOC has developed and validated a new Sport Mental Health Assessment Tool (IOC SMHAT2), offering sports medicine physicians and other professionals a more comprehensive and practical mental health screening method.

items.title: Substance use patterns in elite athletes: a scoping review of alcohol, performance-enhancing drugs and other psychoactive substances
items.summary: A scoping review systematically mapped and synthesized scientific literature on substance use patterns among elite athletes, encompassing recreational substances, performance-enhancing drugs (PEDs), and polysubstance use from inception to March 2025.
items.curatedReason: 这项范围审查系统地描绘了精英运动员的物质使用模式，包括休闲物质、增强表现药物和多重物质使用，为你了解这些运动员群体中的风险因素提供了综合视图。
items.titleZh: 精英运动员物质使用模式：酒精、增强表现药物和其他精神活性物质的范围审查
items.summaryZh: 一项范围审查系统地描绘并综合了截至 2025 年 3 月的精英运动员物质使用模式科学文献，涵盖休闲物质、增强表现药物（PEDs）和多重物质使用。
items.curatedReasonEn: This scoping review systematically maps substance use patterns among elite athletes, including recreational substances, performance-enhancing drugs, and polysubstance use, offering a comprehensive view of risk factors in these athlete populations.
items.limitation: 本研究为范围审查，仅描绘了现有文献，并未进行质量评估或数据合成以得出干预效果的结论。
items.limitationEn: This is a scoping review that only maps existing literature and does not include quality assessment or data synthesis to draw conclusions on intervention effectiveness.

items.title: Post-traumatic stress disorder and related disorders in elite athletes: a narrative review
items.summary: This narrative review examines post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD) and related disorders in elite athletes, highlighting their potential for higher rates due to disproportionate exposure to traumas and stressors and the importance of early detection.
items.curatedReason: 这篇综述提醒你，精英运动员因其经历的创伤和应激源，可能面临较高的创伤后应激障碍（PTSD）及其相关疾病风险。关注其复杂症状表现和应对策略，有助于早期识别和干预。
items.titleZh: 精英运动员的创伤后应激障碍及相关疾病：一项叙述性综述
items.summaryZh: 这篇叙述性综述审视了精英运动员的创伤后应激障碍（PTSD）及相关疾病，强调他们因遭受过多的创伤和应激源而可能面临更高的患病率，并指出早期检测的重要性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This review reminds you that elite athletes may face a higher risk of PTSD and related disorders due to their exposure to traumas and stressors. Paying attention to their complex symptom presentations and coping strategies can aid early identification and intervention.
items.limitation: 本研究为叙述性综述，可能存在选择偏倚，且未对证据质量进行系统评估。
items.limitationEn: This is a narrative review, which may have selection bias and did not systematically assess evidence quality.

items.title: Experiences of frontline physiotherapists during the COVID-19 pandemic at two tertiary hospitals in Southern Malawi: A phenomenological qualitative study
items.summary: A phenomenological qualitative study explored the experiences of 11 frontline physiotherapists during the COVID-19 pandemic at two tertiary hospitals in Southern Malawi, providing insights for future workforce support plans during disease outbreaks.
items.curatedReason: 这项纳入 11 名物理治疗师的定性研究，揭示了非洲欠发达地区医护人员在疫情中的真实困境。制定劳动力支持计划时，不能只看高收入国家的经验。
items.titleZh: COVID-19 大流行期间马拉维南部两家三级医院前线物理治疗师的经历：一项现象学定性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项现象学定性研究探讨了 COVID-19 大流行期间马拉维南部两家三级医院 11 名前线物理治疗师的经历，为未来疾病爆发时制定劳动力支持计划提供了见解。
items.curatedReasonEn: This qualitative study of 11 physiotherapists highlights the real struggles of healthcare workers in underserved African regions during a pandemic. Workforce support plans must consider diverse global experiences, not just those from high-income countries.
items.limitation: 本研究为定性研究，样本量小且局限于马拉维的两个医院，其发现可能不完全适用于其他地区或更大的物理治疗师群体。
items.limitationEn: This qualitative study has a small sample size and is limited to two hospitals in Malawi, so its findings may not be fully applicable to other regions or larger populations of physiotherapists.

items.title: The Influence of Hand Muscle Fatigue on Fine Motor Performance During Selected Activities of Daily Living in Healthy Adults.
items.summary: A study with 30 healthy university students found that hand muscle fatigue significantly impaired fine motor performance and increased task completion time during 11 selected activities of daily living (ADL)-inspired tasks.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究明确指出，手部肌肉疲劳足以损害健康成人进行日常生活活动（ADL）的精细运动表现。在评估患者手功能时，你需要考虑疲劳对其 ADL 能力的潜在影响。
items.titleZh: 手部肌肉疲劳对健康成人特定日常生活活动中精细运动表现的影响
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 30 名健康大学生的研究发现，手部肌肉疲劳显著损害了在 11 项选定的受日常生活活动（ADL）启发的任务中的精细运动表现，并增加了任务完成时间。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study clearly indicates that hand muscle fatigue alone is sufficient to impair fine motor performance during ADLs in healthy adults. When assessing hand function, you need to consider the potential impact of fatigue on patients' ADL capabilities.
items.limitation: 本研究仅限于健康男性和女性大学生，结果可能无法直接推广到有潜在疾病或年龄较大的患者群体。
items.limitationEn: This study was limited to healthy male and female university students, so the results may not be directly generalizable to patient populations with underlying conditions or older adults.

items.title: Refining mental health literacy strategies in elite sport
items.summary: This article discusses refining mental health literacy strategies in elite sport to promote early identification, effective management, and timely help-seeking for mental health symptoms and disorders among athletes.
items.curatedReason: 这份评论文章探讨了在精英体育中提升心理健康素养的重要性，指出了如何塑造对心理健康症状的识别、解读、讨论和应对方式，以促进运动员及时寻求帮助。
items.titleZh: 完善精英体育中的心理健康素养策略
items.summaryZh: 本文讨论了完善精英体育中的心理健康素养策略，以促进运动员心理健康症状和疾病的早期识别、有效管理和及时寻求帮助。
items.curatedReasonEn: This commentary explores the importance of improving mental health literacy in elite sports, outlining how to shape the recognition, interpretation, discussion, and response to mental health symptoms to promote timely help-seeking among athletes.

items.title: Integrating a lived experience workforce to support and enhance mental health and well-being in elite sport
items.summary: This commentary advocates for integrating a 'lived experience workforce' into elite sport mental health support to address athletes' reluctance to seek help due to stigma, low mental health literacy, and concerns about professional understanding.
items.curatedReason: 这项评论呼吁将有亲身经验的工作人员整合到精英体育的心理健康支持中，指出这可以帮助克服运动员寻求帮助时的障碍，如污名化和对专业人士缺乏理解的担忧。
items.titleZh: 整合亲身经验工作者以支持和提升精英体育中的心理健康
items.summaryZh: 这份评论提倡将“有亲身经验的工作者”整合到精英体育的心理健康支持中，以解决运动员因污名化、低心理健康素养以及对专业人士理解不足的担忧而 reluctance 寻求帮助的问题。
items.curatedReasonEn: This commentary calls for integrating individuals with lived experience into elite sport mental health support, noting this can help overcome athlete barriers to help-seeking, such as stigma and concerns about professionals' understanding.

items.title: Understanding the family planning experiences and information needs of people living with multiple sclerosis: an Australian cohort study.
items.summary: An Australian cross-sectional cohort study of 270 individuals with multiple sclerosis (MS) found that 44.0% reported MS impacted reproductive planning decisions, with 14.7% deciding against having children due to MS, highlighting specific information needs.
items.curatedReason: 这项澳大利亚队列研究揭示了多发性硬化症（MS）对患者生育决策的显著影响，提示临床医师应关注 MS 患者在家庭规划方面的独特信息需求。
items.titleZh: 了解多发性硬化症患者的家庭规划经验和信息需求：一项澳大利亚队列研究
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 270 名澳大利亚多发性硬化症（MS）患者的横断面队列研究发现，44.0% 的受访者表示 MS 影响了其生育规划决策，其中 14.7% 因 MS 决定不生育，这突显了其特定的信息需求。
items.curatedReasonEn: This Australian cohort study reveals the significant impact of multiple sclerosis (MS) on patients' reproductive decisions, suggesting clinicians should address the unique family planning information needs of MS patients.
items.limitation: 本研究为横断面调查，无法确立 MS 与家庭规划决策之间的因果关系。
items.limitationEn: This cross-sectional survey cannot establish causality between MS and family planning decisions.

items.title: Contextualising the IOC consensus statement on mental health in elite athletes for low- and middle-income countries
items.summary: This editorial discusses contextualizing the International Olympic Committee (IOC) consensus statement on mental health in elite athletes for low- and middle-income countries (LMICs), proposing adaptations for local implementation given understudied evidence gaps.
items.curatedReason: 这份社论强调了将国际奥委会《精英运动员心理健康共识声明》的建议，应用于中低收入国家时需要进行背景敏感的调整，提示你在不同文化和经济背景下，要考虑政策和实践的本地化。
items.titleZh: 国际奥委会精英运动员心理健康共识声明在中低收入国家的语境化应用
items.summaryZh: 这份社论讨论了如何在低收入和中等收入国家（LMICs）背景下应用国际奥委会（IOC）精英运动员心理健康共识声明，并针对证据不足的领域，提出了本地化实施的调整建议。
items.curatedReasonEn: This editorial highlights the need for context-sensitive adaptation when applying the IOC Consensus Statement on Mental Health in Elite Athletes to low- and middle-income countries, reminding you to consider localization of policies and practices in diverse cultural and economic settings.

items.title: Youth sports and mental health in sub-Saharan Africa
items.summary: This editorial highlights challenges in applying the updated International Olympic Committee (IOC) consensus statement on mental health in elite athletes to youth sports in sub-Saharan Africa due to distinct social, economic, and healthcare contexts.
items.curatedReason: 这份社论指出，国际奥委会的精英运动员心理健康指南在撒哈拉以南非洲的青年体育中实施面临挑战，提醒你在实践中需考虑不同地区的社会、经济和医疗背景差异。
items.titleZh: 撒哈拉以南非洲的青年体育与心理健康
items.summaryZh: 这份社论强调，由于撒哈拉以南非洲独特的社会、经济和医疗背景，在当地青年体育中应用国际奥委会（IOC）最新修订的精英运动员心理健康共识声明面临挑战。
items.curatedReasonEn: This editorial notes that implementing the IOC's elite athlete mental health guidelines in youth sports in Sub-Saharan Africa faces challenges, reminding you to consider social, economic, and healthcare context differences across regions in practice.

items.title: Research priorities for advancing mental health in elite sport: a companion to the IOC consensus statement on mental health in elite athletes
items.summary: This companion article to the IOC consensus statement outlines research priorities for advancing mental health in elite sport, noting a more than threefold increase in peer-reviewed publications on this topic since 2019.
items.curatedReason: 这份研究重点回顾了精英运动员心理健康领域的研究优先事项，揭示了该领域出版物数量的显著增长，为你的研究和临床实践提供了未来关注方向。
items.titleZh: 推动精英体育心理健康的研究优先事项：国际奥委会精英运动员心理健康共识声明的配套文章
items.summaryZh: 这篇国际奥委会共识声明的配套文章概述了推动精英体育心理健康的研究优先事项，指出自 2019 年以来，该主题的同行评审出版物数量增长了三倍多。
items.curatedReasonEn: This review highlights research priorities in elite athlete mental health, revealing a significant increase in publications, providing future directions for your research and clinical practice.

items.title: Physical and mental health-related quality of life outcomes of non-pharmacological interventions in early multiple sclerosis: A systematic review and meta-analysis.
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis found effects of non-pharmacological interventions on physical and mental health-related quality of life among adults with early diagnosed multiple sclerosis, with findings pooled using standardized mean differences.
items.curatedReason: 非药物干预对早期多发性硬化症（MS）患者的身心健康相关生活质量有积极影响。你可以根据这些高级别证据，更自信地将非药物策略纳入早期MS患者的治疗计划中。
items.titleZh: 早期多发性硬化症非药物干预对身心健康相关生活质量结局的影响：一项系统综述和荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项系统综述和荟萃分析发现，非药物干预对早期多发性硬化症成人身心健康相关生活质量具有影响，结果采用标准化均数差进行汇总。
items.curatedReasonEn: Non-pharmacological interventions positively impact physical and mental health-related quality of life in adults with early multiple sclerosis (MS). You can confidently integrate non-pharmacological strategies into early MS patient care plans, supported by this high-level evidence.
items.limitation: 研究未报告效应量和异质性，无法全面评估干预效果的强度和一致性。
items.limitationEn: The study did not report effect sizes and heterogeneity, preventing a comprehensive evaluation of the strength and consistency of intervention effects.

items.title: Exercise Interventions for Older Adults with Alzheimer's Disease: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of 142 articles explored the effectiveness of physical exercise on cognitive function and optimal dosage in older adults with Alzheimer's disease, drawing from Embase, PsycInfo, and Ovid Medline databases.
items.curatedReason: 体育锻炼能有效改善阿尔茨海默病（AD）老年人的认知功能，但最佳剂量尚需个体化考量。你可以将运动疗法作为AD管理的重要组成部分，但需结合患者具体情况调整方案。
items.titleZh: 运动干预对阿尔茨海默病老年人的影响：一项系统综述和荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项对142篇文章的系统综述和荟萃分析，探讨了运动对阿尔茨海默病老年人认知功能的有效性和最佳剂量，数据来源于Embase、PsycInfo和Ovid Medline数据库。
items.curatedReasonEn: Physical exercise effectively improves cognitive function in older adults with Alzheimer's disease (AD), though optimal dosage requires individualized consideration. You can integrate exercise therapy as a key component of AD management, but tailor protocols to each patient's specific needs.
items.limitation: 研究未明确报告具体效应量和异质性，可能影响对干预效果强度和一致性的全面理解。
items.limitationEn: The study did not explicitly report specific effect sizes and heterogeneity, which may limit a comprehensive understanding of the strength and consistency of intervention effects.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

items.title: Clinically interpretable prediction models of stroke functional outcomes: A national cohort study of adults in inpatient rehabilitation facilities in the US.
items.summary: A retrospective cohort study (n=43,745) developed clinically interpretable prediction models for self-care and mobility function at discharge from US inpatient rehabilitation facilities for adults with stroke, using only Inpatient Rehabilitation Facility Patient Assessment Instrument (IRF-PAI) variables.
items.curatedReason: 这项全国性队列研究开发了卒中患者住院康复出院时功能结局的临床预测模型。它基于美国医疗保险和医疗补助服务中心（CMS）强制要求的数据，能为您评估患者出院自理和活动能力提供实用工具。
items.titleZh: 卒中功能结局的临床可解释预测模型：美国住院康复机构成人全国队列研究
items.summaryZh: 一项回顾性队列研究（n=43,745）利用美国住院康复机构患者评估工具（IRF-PAI）变量，为美国卒中成人住院康复出院时的自理和活动功能开发了临床可解释的预测模型。
items.curatedReasonEn: This national cohort study developed clinically interpretable prediction models for stroke functional outcomes at discharge from inpatient rehabilitation. Based on data mandated by CMS, it provides a practical tool for you to assess patients' self-care and mobility at discharge.
items.limitation: 这是一个回顾性队列研究，结果可能受数据报告完整性和准确性的限制，且模型在其他人群或医疗系统中的外推性需验证。
items.limitationEn: This was a retrospective cohort study, and results may be limited by the completeness and accuracy of data reporting; generalizability of the model to other populations or healthcare systems needs validation.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

items.title: Effect of kinesiology taping on limb oedema in patients with severe hyper-dependency using shear-wave elastography: a randomized clinical trial.
items.summary: A randomized clinical trial (n=50) demonstrated that kinesiology taping at 25% tension significantly reduced the elastic coefficient of the dermis in patients with limb oedema compared to 0% tension taping by day 9, with effects sustained to day 16.
items.curatedReason: 肌内效贴布（25%张力）能显著降低严重肢体水肿患者真皮的弹性系数，效果持续至第 16 天。在处理这类水肿时，可以考虑使用 25% 张力的肌内效贴布作为有效干预手段。
items.titleZh: 肌内效贴布对重度依赖性肢体水肿患者的影响：一项随机临床试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机临床试验（n=50）表明，与0%张力贴布相比，25%张力肌内效贴布在第9天显著降低了肢体水肿患者真皮的弹性系数，效果持续至第16天。
items.curatedReasonEn: Kinesiology taping at 25% tension significantly reduces the elastic coefficient of the dermis in patients with severe limb oedema, with effects sustained up to day 16. When managing such oedema, consider using kinesiology taping at 25% tension as an effective intervention.
items.limitation: 试验随访期较短（16天），长期效果和机制需进一步研究。
items.limitationEn: The trial's follow-up period was relatively short (16 days), and long-term effects and mechanisms require further investigation.

items.title: Virtual reality-assisted rehabilitation after arthroscopic rotator cuff repair for small-to-medium supraspinatus tears: a prospective assessor-blinded randomized controlled trial
items.summary: A prospective assessor-blinded randomized controlled trial examined virtual reality-assisted rehabilitation after arthroscopic rotator cuff repair for small-to-medium supraspinatus tears, noting VR's potential to standardize tasks and provide feedback.
items.curatedReason: 对于小型至中型冈上肌撕裂关节镜肩袖修复术后的康复，VR 辅助康复是一种可行方案。你可以考虑将其引入临床，因为它在标准化任务和即时反馈方面表现良好，且有 RCT 证据支持。
items.titleZh: 虚拟现实辅助康复对小型至中型冈上肌撕裂关节镜肩袖修复术后的影响：一项前瞻性评估者盲法随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项前瞻性评估者盲法随机对照试验研究了虚拟现实辅助康复对小型至中型冈上肌撕裂关节镜肩袖修复术后的影响，指出VR在标准化任务和提供反馈方面的潜力。
items.curatedReasonEn: For rehabilitation after arthroscopic rotator cuff repair of small-to-medium supraspinatus tears, VR-assisted rehabilitation is a viable option. You can consider introducing it into your clinic, as it performs well in standardizing tasks and providing immediate feedback, with RCT evidence to back it up.
items.limitation: 研究仅限于小型至中型冈上肌撕裂，结果对外科修复类型和损伤程度的普遍性可能有限。
items.limitationEn: The study was limited to small-to-medium supraspinatus tears, so the generalizability of the results to other surgical repair types and injury severities may be limited.

items.title: Slow eccentric- versus concentric-focused resistance training in middle-aged and older women with knee osteoarthritis: A randomized trial
items.summary: A randomized trial compared the short-term effects of slow eccentric-only resistance training (SET) and slow concentric-only resistance training (SCT) on pain and physical function in middle-aged and older women with knee osteoarthritis.
items.curatedReason: 治疗膝骨关节炎中老年女性的疼痛和功能障碍，慢速离心训练和慢速向心训练都有效。这项 RCT 提示，在短期效果上，两者没有显著差异，选择哪种方式取决于患者的依从性和设备可及性。
items.titleZh: 慢速离心训练与向心训练对膝骨关节炎中老年女性的影响：一项随机试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机试验比较了慢速离心阻力训练（SET）和慢速向心阻力训练（SCT）对膝骨关节炎中老年女性疼痛和身体功能的短期效果。
items.curatedReasonEn: Both slow eccentric and slow concentric resistance training are effective for treating pain and functional limitations in middle-aged and older women with knee osteoarthritis. This RCT suggests there's no significant short-term difference between them, so your choice might depend on patient adherence and equipment availability.
items.limitation: 研究仅评估了短期效果，长期疗效和依从性尚不明确。
items.limitationEn: The study only assessed short-term effects, and long-term efficacy and adherence remain unclear.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Nordic walking and sprinting enhance lower limb vertical power in Parkinson’s: an exploratory study
items.summary: An exploratory study found that Nordic walking and sprinting enhanced lower limb vertical power, specifically jump height and peak power, in individuals with Parkinson's disease.
items.curatedReason: 这项探索性研究发现北欧式行走和冲刺训练能增强帕金森病（PD）患者的下肢垂直力量。它为您在PD患者康复中引入这类高强度运动提供了初步证据，有助于改善患者的运动功能。
items.titleZh: 北欧式行走和冲刺训练增强帕金森病患者下肢垂直力量：一项探索性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项探索性研究发现，北欧式行走和冲刺训练能增强帕金森病患者的下肢垂直力量，特别是跳跃高度和峰值力量。
items.curatedReasonEn: This exploratory study found that Nordic walking and sprinting enhance lower limb vertical power in Parkinson's disease (PD) patients. It provides preliminary evidence for introducing such high-intensity exercises into PD rehabilitation, helping to improve patients' motor function.
items.limitation: 这是一项探索性研究，样本量较小，结论需要更大规模的随机对照试验验证。
items.limitationEn: This was an exploratory study with a small sample size, and the conclusions require validation through larger randomized controlled trials.

items.title: Reliability and construct validity of three movement-evoked pain methods in individuals with knee osteoarthritis.
items.summary: This study evaluated the reliability and construct validity of three movement-evoked pain (MEP) calculation methods in 111 individuals with knee osteoarthritis, finding acceptable test-retest reliability and construct validity for all methods.
items.curatedReason: 三种运动诱发疼痛测量方法在膝骨关节炎患者中是可靠且有效的。在临床评估中，你可以放心使用这些方法，它们能提供准确的疼痛反馈。
items.titleZh: 膝骨关节炎患者运动诱发疼痛三种测量方法的信度和结构效度
items.summaryZh: 这项研究评估了111名膝骨关节炎患者三种运动诱发疼痛（MEP）计算方法的信度和结构效度，发现所有方法都具有可接受的重测信度和结构效度。
items.curatedReasonEn: Three movement-evoked pain measurement methods for knee osteoarthritis are reliable and valid. You can confidently use these methods in clinical assessments, as they provide accurate pain feedback.
items.limitation: 这是一项二次分析，样本量适中，研究人群为巴西单中心患者，可能影响结果的普遍性。
items.limitationEn: This was a secondary analysis with a moderate sample size, and the study population from a single center in Brazil may limit generalizability.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

items.title: Feasibility and acceptability of the breakfast group intervention BISTRo for stroke survivors in acute rehabilitation.
items.summary: A multisite mixed-methods feasibility study with 16 stroke survivors and 53 multidisciplinary staff examined the feasibility and acceptability of the BISTRo breakfast group intervention delivered in acute stroke rehabilitation in the UK, finding it feasible and acceptable.
items.curatedReason: 在英国急性卒中康复环境中，BISTRo 早餐小组干预是可行且可接受的。你可以考虑在你的临床实践中引入类似的集体用餐和社交活动，以促进患者的积极参与和多学科协作。
items.titleZh: 急性康复期卒中幸存者早餐组干预 BISTRo 的可行性和可接受性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项针对16名卒中幸存者和53名多学科工作人员的多中心混合方法可行性研究，评估了在英国急性卒中康复服务中实施早餐组干预 BISTRo 的可行性和可接受性，发现该干预措施是可行的且可接受。
items.curatedReasonEn: The BISTRo breakfast group intervention is feasible and acceptable in acute stroke rehabilitation in the UK. You might consider introducing similar communal dining and social activities in your practice to foster patient engagement and multidisciplinary collaboration.
items.limitation: 这是一个小样本的多中心可行性研究，结果可能不完全适用于所有临床环境，需更大规模验证。
items.limitationEn: This was a small-sample, multisite feasibility study, and the results may not be fully applicable to all clinical settings; larger-scale validation is needed.

items.title: Methodological characteristics of perturbation-based balance training in healthy older adults: A scoping review.
items.summary: This scoping review systematically mapped and characterized the methodological features of mechanically induced perturbation-based balance training interventions in healthy older adults, highlighting methodological variability that limits synthesis and clinical translation.
items.curatedReason: 这项范围综述系统地绘制并描述了健康老年人扰动训练（PBT）的现有方法学特征。它指出了PBT在防跌倒方面的潜力，但强调了方法学差异限制了临床转化，提示您在应用时需关注其具体实施细节。
items.titleZh: 健康老年人扰动平衡训练的方法学特征：一项范围综述
items.summaryZh: 这项范围综述系统地绘制并描述了健康老年人机械诱导扰动平衡训练干预的方法学特征，强调了限制综合和临床转化的方法学变异性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This scoping review systematically mapped and characterized the methodological features of perturbation-based balance training (PBT) in healthy older adults. It highlights PBT's potential for fall prevention but emphasizes that methodological variability limits clinical translation, suggesting you pay attention to specific implementation details when applying it.
items.limitation: 范围综述侧重于方法学特征，未深入评估PBT的临床疗效或安全性。
items.limitationEn: The scoping review focused on methodological characteristics and did not deeply assess the clinical efficacy or safety of PBT.

items.title: What is the Journey to Physiotherapy Care for Women over 60 Years with Pelvic Floor Dysfunction: Scoping Review
items.summary: A scoping review explored the journey to physiotherapy care for women over 60 years with pelvic floor dysfunction, noting that despite physiotherapy being first-line care, few older women seek professional help.
items.curatedReason: 60 岁以上女性盆底功能障碍的物理治疗需求被严重低估。作为一线治疗，我们必须正视这些老年女性在寻求专业帮助时面临的障碍，并主动思考如何改善服务可及性。
items.titleZh: 60岁以上女性盆底功能障碍患者寻求物理治疗的途径：一项范围综述
items.summaryZh: 一项范围综述探讨了60岁以上女性盆底功能障碍患者寻求物理治疗的途径，指出尽管物理治疗是首选治疗，但很少有老年女性寻求专业帮助。
items.curatedReasonEn: The need for physiotherapy in women over 60 with pelvic floor dysfunction is severely underestimated. As a first-line treatment, we must confront the barriers these older women face in seeking professional help and proactively consider how to improve access to services.
items.limitation: 范围综述主要侧重于路径探索，未能深入评估具体干预措施的有效性或患者结局。
items.limitationEn: The scoping review primarily focused on exploring pathways and did not deeply assess the effectiveness of specific interventions or patient outcomes.

items.title: Systematic review on the association between brain-related measures and upper limb movement characteristics after stroke
items.summary: This systematic review examined the association between brain-related measures and upper limb movement characteristics after stroke, providing a comprehensive overview of the current evidence.
items.curatedReason: 卒中后上肢功能恢复的神经影像学和生物标志物研究仍在发展中。这项系统综述提供了现有证据的全貌，但目前这些脑相关测量在临床上用于精准预测或指导治疗的价值仍有限，尚不能作为常规操作。
items.titleZh: 卒中后脑相关测量与上肢运动特征之间关联的系统综述
items.summaryZh: 这项系统综述研究了卒中后脑相关测量与上肢运动特征之间的关联，提供了当前证据的全面概述。
items.curatedReasonEn: Neuroimaging and biomarker research for upper limb recovery post-stroke is still evolving. This systematic review offers a comprehensive overview of current evidence, but the clinical utility of these brain-related measures for precise prediction or guiding treatment is currently limited and not yet a routine practice.
items.limitation: 综述未报告纳入研究的异质性或具体的效应量，可能影响结果的综合解释。
items.limitationEn: The review did not report the heterogeneity of included studies or specific effect sizes, which might affect the comprehensive interpretation of the results.

items.title: Cross-cultural adaptation and psychometric assessment of the Chinese version of the University of Wisconsin Running Injury and Recovery Index in runners
items.summary: This study performed cross-cultural adaptation and psychometric assessment of the Chinese version of the University of Wisconsin Running Injury and Recovery Index (UWRI) in runners, aiming to validate a patient-reported outcome measure for running-related injury (RRI).
items.curatedReason: 现在你可以使用中文版的威斯康星大学跑步损伤与恢复指数（UWRI）了。这项研究完成了其跨文化适应和心理测量评估，为中国跑步人群的跑步相关损伤评估提供了一个可靠的患者报告结局量表。
items.titleZh: 威斯康星大学跑步损伤与恢复指数中文版在跑步者中的跨文化适应与心理测量评估
items.summaryZh: 本研究对威斯康星大学跑步损伤与恢复指数（UWRI）的中文版在跑步者中进行了跨文化适应和心理测量评估，旨在验证跑步相关损伤（RRI）的患者报告结局测量工具。
items.curatedReasonEn: You can now use the Chinese version of the University of Wisconsin Running Injury and Recovery Index (UWRI). This study completed its cross-cultural adaptation and psychometric assessment, providing a reliable patient-reported outcome measure for running-related injury assessment in Chinese runners.
items.limitation: 研究人群集中在中国，结果的普遍性可能受限。
items.limitationEn: The study population was concentrated in China, which may limit the generalizability of the results.

items.title: Effects of proprioceptive neuromuscular facilitation on flexibility and neuromuscular performance in gymnastics: a systematic review
items.summary: A systematic review explored the effects of proprioceptive neuromuscular facilitation (PNF) interventions on flexibility and neuromuscular performance in gymnastics, aiming to describe available evidence and identify limitations.
items.curatedReason: PNF（本体感觉神经肌肉促进法）在体操运动员柔韧性和神经肌肉表现中可能有效，但现有系统综述指出证据有限。在应用 PNF 时，你仍需结合个体情况谨慎评估，不要过度承诺其效果。
items.titleZh: 本体感觉神经肌肉促进法对体操运动员柔韧性和神经肌肉表现的影响：一项系统综述
items.summaryZh: 一项系统综述探讨了本体感觉神经肌肉促进法（PNF）干预对体操运动员柔韧性和神经肌肉表现的影响，旨在描述现有证据并识别其局限性。
items.curatedReasonEn: PNF (proprioceptive neuromuscular facilitation) might be effective for flexibility and neuromuscular performance in gymnasts, but the current systematic review highlights limited evidence. When applying PNF, you should still evaluate cautiously based on individual circumstances and avoid over-promising its effects.
items.limitation: 综述指出现有证据存在局限性，未提供具体的效应量和异质性，可能影响临床决策的强度。
items.limitationEn: The review noted limitations in existing evidence and did not provide specific effect sizes and heterogeneity, which might affect the strength of clinical decisions.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Effects of hyperbaric oxygen therapy on human musculoskeletal pathologies in clinical studies: a systematic review
items.summary: A systematic review examined the effects of hyperbaric oxygen therapy (HBOT) on human musculoskeletal pathologies in clinical studies, focusing on its capacity to enhance tissue oxygenation, reduce inflammation, and accelerate healing.
items.curatedReason: 高压氧疗法（HBOT）在肌肉骨骼疾病中的应用仍处于探索阶段。尽管它理论上能改善氧合、减轻炎症，但这项系统综述提示，临床证据尚不足以广泛推荐，尤其在运动员康复中，引入前仍需审慎评估其真实疗效。
items.titleZh: 高压氧疗法对人类肌肉骨骼病理影响的临床研究系统综述
items.summaryZh: 一项系统综述研究了高压氧疗法（HBOT）在临床研究中对人类肌肉骨骼病理的影响，重点关注其增强组织氧合、减轻炎症和加速愈合的能力。
items.curatedReasonEn: Hyperbaric oxygen therapy (HBOT) in musculoskeletal pathologies is still an exploratory area. Although it theoretically improves oxygenation and reduces inflammation, this systematic review suggests that clinical evidence is insufficient for widespread recommendation. Especially in athlete rehabilitation, a careful evaluation of its true efficacy is needed before implementation.
items.limitation: 综述未报告具体的效应量和异质性，可能限制对HBOT干预效果强度和一致性的全面理解。
items.limitationEn: The review did not report specific effect sizes and heterogeneity, which may limit a comprehensive understanding of the strength and consistency of HBOT intervention effects.

items.title: Systemic inflammation as a mediator of exercise benefits in chronic low back pain: Refining the mechanistic lens.
items.summary: This article discusses the role of systemic inflammation as a mediator of exercise benefits in chronic low back pain, aiming to refine the mechanistic understanding of exercise therapy.
items.curatedReason: 本综述探讨了慢性下腰痛中全身炎症在运动疗效中的介导作用。它为您理解运动如何改善慢性疼痛提供了更深层的生理机制视角，有助于优化治疗方案。
items.titleZh: 全身炎症作为慢性下腰痛运动益处的介质：深化机制视角
items.summaryZh: 本文探讨了全身炎症在慢性下腰痛运动益处中的介导作用，旨在深化运动疗法的机制理解。
items.curatedReasonEn: Systemic inflammation is a key mediator of exercise benefits in chronic low back pain. Understanding this mechanism can help you design more precise exercise protocols to maximize anti-inflammatory and analgesic effects.

items.title: "It's really, really just exercise I put my faith in now": Patients' perspectives on rotator cuff tendinopathy management: A qualitative study.
items.summary: A qualitative study explored the perspectives of 14 international patients with rotator cuff tendinopathy, identifying 33 subthemes across three main themes regarding their experiences and management priorities, including clarity on symptom onset and treatment outcomes.
items.curatedReason: 这项定性研究提供了肩袖肌腱病患者对治疗管理的直接看法。它强调了患者在治疗中对明确诊断和治疗结果的重视，以及对倾听和验证感受的临床医生的需求，有助于改善医患沟通。
items.titleZh: “我现在真的只相信运动了”：肩袖肌腱病患者对治疗管理的看法：一项定性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项定性研究探讨了14名国际肩袖肌腱病患者对治疗管理的看法，识别了围绕症状发作清晰度、治疗结果及倾听型临床医生等优先事项的3个主题下33个子主题。
items.curatedReasonEn: This qualitative study offers direct patient perspectives on rotator cuff tendinopathy management. It highlights patients' prioritization of clear diagnoses and treatment outcomes, alongside valuing clinicians who listen and validate their experiences, which can improve patient-clinician communication.
items.limitation: 研究样本量小（14人）且为国际线上访谈，结果可能不具普遍代表性。
items.limitationEn: The study involved a small sample (14 participants) and international online interviews, which may limit the generalizability of the findings.

items.title: Development and Content Validation of an Exercise-Based Framework for the Management of Lumbar Radiculopathy.
items.summary: This study focused on the development and content validation of an exercise-based framework for lumbar radiculopathy, aiming to integrate various evidence-based exercise approaches and clinical expertise.
items.curatedReason: 本研究开发并验证了腰椎神经根病基于运动的治疗框架。该框架尝试将不同的循证运动方法和临床专业知识进行结构化整合，为您提供了临床实践中的潜在工具。
items.titleZh: 腰椎神经根病运动治疗框架的开发与内容验证
items.summaryZh: 本研究致力于开发并验证腰椎神经根病基于运动的治疗框架，旨在整合各种循证运动方法和临床专业知识。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study developed and validated an exercise-based framework for lumbar radiculopathy. This framework attempts to integrate different evidence-based exercise approaches and clinical expertise in a structured way, providing a potential tool for your clinical practice.
items.limitation: 本研究仅为内容验证，尚未进行临床疗效评估。
items.limitationEn: This study only focused on content validation and has not yet evaluated clinical efficacy.
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: Upper-Limb Paresis Severity Is Associated With Practice Dosage During Task-Oriented Training in Subacute Stroke-An Exploratory Secondary Analysis.
items.summary: An exploratory secondary analysis of 33 individuals with subacute stroke found that upper-limb paresis severity was associated with practice dosage during task-oriented training.
items.curatedReason: 这项对亚急性卒中患者上肢任务导向训练的探索性分析发现，偏瘫严重程度与训练剂量相关。它提示在设计康复方案时，需要考虑患者基线偏瘫程度对重复训练量的影响。
items.titleZh: 亚急性卒中患者上肢偏瘫严重程度与任务导向训练剂量相关性：一项探索性二次分析
items.summaryZh: 一项针对33名亚急性卒中患者的探索性二次分析发现，上肢偏瘫的严重程度与任务导向训练期间的练习剂量相关。
items.curatedReasonEn: This exploratory analysis of upper-limb task-oriented training in subacute stroke found an association between paresis severity and practice dosage. It suggests that when designing rehabilitation programs, you need to consider the impact of a patient's baseline paresis level on the achievable repetition volume.
items.limitation: 这是一项探索性二次分析，样本量较小（33人），且为单中心数据，结果需要进一步的验证。
items.limitationEn: This was an exploratory secondary analysis with a relatively small sample size (33 participants) and single-center data, so the findings require further validation.
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: Respiratory Function in Participants with Spinal Cord Injury of a Rehabilitation Center using Neuromuscular Electrical Stimulation.
items.summary: This cross-sectional study observed the respiratory function of 25 individuals with chronic spinal cord injury who had participated in a neuromuscular electrical stimulation (NMES) rehabilitation program for at least three years, comparing those with tetraplegia (n=6) and paraplegia (n=16).
items.curatedReason: 本研究观察了接受神经肌肉电刺激（NMES）康复项目的脊髓损伤（SCI）患者的呼吸功能。它提供了一组长期接受NMES治疗的SCI患者呼吸功能的横断面数据，有助于了解其生理状态。
items.titleZh: 康复中心接受神经肌肉电刺激的脊髓损伤患者呼吸功能观察
